findings.claim: The entry's code=1 refusal (MRS_ERR_CONVERSION) fired at lmf_to_native_loader_facts.cpp:228-231 (derive_readable_ranges returned zero intervals intersecting the extent). Terminal event chain @2274097-2276081: 5 data windows verified+matched at the candidate base (anchor_match 0x0000_0001..0x0004_0001), window 5 not covered, anchor_c_either=1, then lmf caps vmentry=2(Ok) vm_scan=2(Ok) linkmap=1(Failed), provider_code=0xfffff05f (-4001 = kRefusalExecHandleRawZeroIngame, the known in-game g1 exec_handle raw-0 refusal - NOT a scan failure), identity_source=2 (VmScan), runtime_start_failed=0x1. Contradiction at the heart of the bug: the bridge's own registration query found 6 readable spans intersecting the extent minutes earlier in the same attempt (@2270807), while the conversion's snapshot derived ZERO intersecting intervals. bridge_cfg_gamedir/bridge_cfg_workdir are ABSENT from the whole delta - expected for the entry (conversion failed before the attach point at r13 lines 668-671), so the in-log record contains no direct Resolution-B attach evidence for launch-9.
